objective: Proof: from the cube Q_s the cheapest steps are the subdivisions and pendants; after either, every missing combination has a three-knot certificate, and certificates survive later fills; so the cheapest growth reaches Q_d at n = 2^d for every d.
status: Proved 2026-11-18 (referee pending): under the cheapest rule (fewest states, up to three betweenness knots per step, A99, any tie rule), from one knot the base at n = 2^d is the cube Q_d for every d >= 2 in every run (STATE-RULES S6): from Q_s the cheapest steps are the subdivisions and pendants, after either every unoccupied orientation has a three-knot certificate, and certificates survive fills.
title: The cube at every doubling
